# A made-up case for tests/test_law.rex, under CMA 1990 s.3ZA (E.W.): no real person, place or system.
# Written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-29; 2026-10-30: (a) split into element 1 (the person did it) and element 2
# (it was unauthorised): one element taking both kinds was satisfied by either one alone.  The key's signature
# re-bound to CREDENTIAL_USED (it shows the key was used, as in the s.1 case after Gemini's review); R placed
# at the console by the badge record and camera.  step | element | SUPPORT or REBUT | tier | binding | text
1 | 1 | SUPPORT | PROVENANCE | CREDENTIAL_USED | the change to the scheduler of system H was signed with R's key
1 | 1 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | PERSON_ACT | the badge record and the camera on that floor put R at the console when the change was made
1 | 2 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | AUTHORITY | R's written access list does not include the scheduler of system H
1 | 3 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | KNOWLEDGE_UNAUTHORISED | R's own message: i am not meant to touch the scheduler
1 | 3 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | RECKLESSNESS_DAMAGE | R's own message: it might take the system down, but i will run it
1 | 4 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | MATERIAL_DAMAGE | the incident log: system H stopped for 6 hours, and the clinics that use it stopped
1 | 5 | SUPPORT | DOCUMENTARY | RECKLESSNESS_DAMAGE | R's own message: it might take the system down, but i will run it
